main_text.p: mus : & tutò quidem istud; quot pias pudicasque fœminas nouimus, quas malè-moratæ sororis dispuduit,. quęque germanum prostibulum haud parum oderint ? Illud idem nobis istic vsu venit; Roma hæretica est, idololatrica est; meretricium apud se suum exerceat ; nobis cum illa tali cohabitare ( salua pudicitia) non licuit; huius nos extrusit nequitia, pepulere vires : Cedimus loco, & mœsti interim conquerimur, Quomodo ef- festa est meretrix vrbs fidelis, & plenissima iure in qua iusti- tia pernoctabat, ea nunc ho- micidarum plena est ; Argen-

page.notes: The marginal reference "Esa.1.21.22." stands in the left margin beside the column; it is printed in the margin and is given above as a foot note. Faint show-through from the reverse side is ignored. The word "tum" at the end of the last line is the continuation word after the column; it is set at the right foot of the column. Some words in the top lines are faint and were read with care.
